title: Unmasking On-Policy Distillation: Where It Helps, Where It Hurts, and Why
abstract: arXiv:2605.10889v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation offers dense, per-token supervision for training reasoning models; however, it remains unclear under which conditions this signal is beneficial and under which it is detrimental. Which teacher model should be used, and in the case of self-distillation, which specific context should serve as the supervisory signal? Does the optimal choice vary from one token to the next? At present, addressing these questions typically requires costly training runs whose aggregate performance metrics obscure the dynamics at the level of individual tokens. We introduce a training-free diagnostic framework that operates at the highest resolution: per token, per question, and per teacher. We derive an ideal per-node gradient defined as the parameter update that maximally increases the student's probability of success. translated_title: 揭开在线策略蒸馏的面纱：它何时有效、何时有害以及原因
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏为训练推理模型提供了密集的逐token监督信号；然而，这种信号在哪些条件下有益、在哪些条件下有害，目前仍不清楚。应该使用哪个教师模型？在自蒸馏的情况下，哪个特定的上下文应作为监督信号？最优选择是否会因token的不同而变化？目前，回答这些问题通常需要代价高昂的训练运行，而其汇总的性能指标掩盖了单个token层面的动态过程。我们引入了一个无需训练的诊断框架，它以最高分辨率运行：逐token、逐问题、逐教师。我们推导出一个理想的逐节点梯度，其定义为能够最大程度提高学生模型成功概率的参数更新。随后，我们开发了一种可扩展的定向采样算法来高效估计该梯度，即使对于长链（推理过程）也适用……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需训练的高分辨率诊断框架，通过推导理想的逐节点梯度并开发可扩展的定向采样算法，揭示了在线策略蒸馏在训练推理模型时何时有益、何时有害。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a training-free, high-resolution diagnostic framework that derives an ideal per-node gradient and develops a scalable targeted-rollout algorithm to reveal when on-policy distillation helps or hurts when training reasoning models.
